origin.description: Run code in another time zone.
origin.details: The zone is restored afterwards. Naive localtime follows TZ once the zone cache is refreshed.

translation.description: Run code in another time zone.
translation.details: The zone is restored afterwards. Naive localtime follows TZ once the zone cache is refreshed. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

import time
return with_timezone(
    "Europe/Paris",
    lambda: time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", time.localtime(1579090000)),
)
